title: Project Associate, Project Technician, Project Support Staff, Project Engineer / PS&O Executive, Senior Project Engineer / Module Lead / Project Leader, Project Officer, Project Manager / Program Manager / Program Delivery Manager / Knowledge Partner, Project Head, Administrative Associate
qualification: BE/B.Tech or equivalent degree (min 60% or equivalent CGPA for most posts; 50% for Project Associate at some centres) OR PG in Science/Computer Application/relevant domain with requisite percentage OR ME/M.Tech OR Ph.D. in relevant discipline – from AICTE/UGC-approved institution or recognized university. For support/admin posts: Graduation with 50% + relevant experience.
salary: Project Associate: Rs. 28,750 – Rs. 35,000/month | Project Engineer: Rs. 39,100 – Rs. 50,000/month | Senior Project Engineer: Rs. 60,000 – Rs. 75,000/month | Project Manager: Rs. 64,000 – Rs. 1,60,000/month (varies by centre and domain)
age_limit: Upper age limits vary by position level and are calculated as on the last date of application, i.e., 20 June 2026. SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and Government employees are eligible for age relaxation as per Government of India norms.
application_fee: C-DAC charges absolutely no application fee for any position under this recruitment cycle - this applies to all categories including General, SC, ST, OBC, EWS, and PwBD candidates across all 11 centres.
